metadata.chapter: Chapter 23 - CABLE FRANCHISE APPLICATION AND PROCESS

content.title: Chapter 23 - CABLE FRANCHISE APPLICATION AND PROCESS — Sec. 23-38. - Application fee.
content.summary:
Arvada shall, by resolution, set an application fee sufficient to cover the reasonable
               cost of processing applications under this chapter.
(
Ord. No. 4078, § 1, 7-16-07
)
